task: ids-model-check (flagship 12): bSDD units to measure types for --from-bsdd
errors: First unit mapping picked the first QUDT kind that names a measure: dB became sound power level on 254 pressure-level properties and m3/kPa became section modulus/modulus of elasticity; caught by the corpus inventory before commit and fixed (general-kind rule, ambiguous dimensionless -> none).
First corpus run with units drew 18 false bsdd-value warnings (kPa values written in Pa vs bSDD's literal values); bsdd.mjs now compares measure facets in SI.
A shell grep stripped a needed line from the saved IfcTester script; rewritten and rerun.

doc_friction.issue: Its sample depends on which bSDD calls 429; two runs over a partly cold cache picked 168, 182, 185 and 188 classes, so before/after totals only compare when both runs read one warm cache (added --no-units for that).
buildable: had 3 characters to spare; replacing a landed item with a new one took three tries to fit 600 characters.

notes: Built bsdd-units.mjs + schema/bsdd-units.json (bSDD /api/Unit/v1 joined to QUDT unit Turtle, CC BY 4.0; bSDD's '°' -> QUDT GRAD link relinked to DEG). --from-bsdd writes Real properties as the IFC measure their unit names with values/bounds in SI; dimensionless, unknown, conflicting or two-unit-with-values cases stay IFCREAL with a note. Inventory: 867 of 1,625 non-IFC Real class properties (18 of 22 dictionaries) get a measure; 37 state a dimension contradicting their unit. Same 188 classes with/without units: measure facets 1 -> 454, audit 39/43 clean both, link check 43/43 no error both. Built-model check (tiny-house + 3 walls): IFCREAL failed the 200 mm IfcLengthMeasure wall, new facet passes it and fails 500 mm; IfcTester 0.9.0 agrees 9/9. Verification: run_venture_tests.py ids-model-check ok (348 tests), check_posts ok, validate.py ok, venture-preflight run (see PR).

pricing.source: Anthropic pricing as cached in the Claude API skill (models table and per-model migration notes), 2026-10-06. Cache writes are 1.25x input (5-minute) and 2x input (1-hour); cache reads differ by model.

human_equivalent.basis: unit table from bSDD+QUDT, measure mapping, SI conversion, link-check fix, corpus and IfcTester checks: about 1.5 days for a BIM tooling developer

certainty.tokens: high: summed from the per-request `usage` the API returned, as the transcript recorded it, deduplicated by message id
certainty.model: high: the `model` field on each API response, not the configured model
certainty.api_equivalent_usd: medium: measured tokens x list prices in prompts/pricing.json (as_of stated); an equivalent, not a charge: these runs are billed under a subscription
certainty.time: medium: from transcript timestamps; model time is request-to-response, tool time is call-to-result, time waiting on a person is excluded from active time
certainty.human_equivalent: low: the agent's own estimate of how long a competent person would take, with its basis written down; never measured

not_counted: requests the harness makes outside the transcript (context compaction summaries, title generation, safety classifiers), if any
transcripts lost when a cloud session moved to a new container: only files present in this container are read, so a resumed session can undercount
server-tool fees (web search is billed per search, not per token); the count is recorded, not priced
